description: This file defines the `CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler` class, which acts as a message handler for web view interactions related to the Canvas A2 UI. It processes JavaScript messages, extracts action data, and communicates with backend services to handle user actions from a web-based canvas interface.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler
classes.description: A final class implementing WKScriptMessageHandler that processes JavaScript messages from a web view related to Canvas A2 UI actions, manages URL schemes, and forwards user actions to backend services.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkCanvasURL
methods.description: Checks whether a given URL points to a local network resource based on its scheme and host/IP.

methods.name: userContentController:didReceive:
methods.description: Handles incoming messages from the web view, extracts the action details, and sends an agent message to the backend.

methods.name: parseIPv4
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address from a host string, returning its byte components if valid.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Determines if a given IPv4 address belongs to a local network range based on common private address blocks.
